University of Bath

A leading UK university with an international reputation for teaching and research excellence.

Find out about our courses

Bath reaches top 125 in QS World University Rankings 2027

We are proud to have risen seven places since last year, achieving our highest ranking since the introduction of independent rankings in 2010.

Result highlights

This is the fourth consecutive year that we have featured in the QS Top 150, placing us in the top 10% of universities worldwide.

Further highlights include rankings of:

  • 56th for Sustainability
  • 91st for Employer Reputation
Find out more about our QS ranking

Studying at Bath

Whichever course you choose, your studies are informed by the most recent discoveries and thinking.

Employability

Bath graduates are highly valued and sought after by leading graduate employers.

For over a decade, the University of Bath has been ranked within the top ten best universities in the UK for graduate prospects.

Learn more about our rankings

Quality of education

Our academic staff are experts in their fields who want to share their knowledge and skills with you. They'll encourage and challenge you, helping you to reach your full potential.

Explore our courses

Our location

If you choose to live and study at Bath, you can enjoy a blend of campus and city life in a world-famous location.

Bath has been ranked as the second safest city in England and Wales by the Complete University Guide 2025.

Find out what it's like to live in Bath

Global research

Our research is improving lives and changing the world we live in.

Research with Impact

Our research is helping to change the world for the better. Through collaborative partnerships, we're creating a healthier, more sustainable, and connected future for all.

Read more about our research

Our research institutes

Our research institutes cover a broad range of areas, where teams collaborate to support our three primary institutional research themes: Sustainability, Health & Wellbeing, and Digital.

Find out more about our research institutes

Innovation and enterprise

We work with businesses, researchers, and students to enable new ideas, innovation, and growth.

Collaborate with us

Sport University of the Year 2026
